# Home climate
One shared season. A temperature and schedule for each room.

cards.content: Default temperatures apply when a temperature schedule or override is not supplying the target. Editing these controls keeps schedules enabled. **Copy global default** copies the current value once.

The global control changes stored defaults for all 12 rooms, including exceptions. It does not enable rooms. **Floor 2 must remain off because of the leak.** Upstairs controls are omitted from this dashboard.
